note: The CraftScript analysis library (docs/SCRIPTING-SPEC.md section 4, docs/apps/craftscript.md 'The analysis library'). Every item is a .craft file in this folder named after it; each file's header states what it computes, the method, units, limits, references and its check (bin/test-craftscript.mjs --lib).
